attribution.localizedCause: The exact pre-FF total is the ordinary BF16 residual sum once both inputs have correct promotion-backed lineage; no special merge, raw branch, or coordinate correction is required.

decision.rationale: Advance to the layer-19 attention output projection: capture and independently validate the production pre-w_o value tensor and its input adjoint, then reconstruct w_o_19 and its transpose residual under already attributed matmul schedules.

hypothesis.rationale: One F32 addition followed by RNE BF16 of the exact output-order RMSNorm branch and promoted streaming-dot direct residual reproduces all 2,097,152 source pre-FF total-adjoint words.

retiredDimensions: Special pre-FF residual-merge semantics beyond one F32 addition and RNE BF16 on exact inputs.
transferableLessons: Promoted artifact lineage is part of the arithmetic contract: the same operation can appear inexact when a superseded upstream artifact is silently reused.
uncertainties: This is zero-credit teacher-removal evidence on one retained 64-state population; attention backward, recursive update, compression transfer, and Hutter score remain unproven.

reasons: The complete teacher-free composition ran twice from promotion-backed branch and direct artifacts, matched every sealed source-total word, preserved a live negative control, validated dependencies and source closure, stayed inside resource limits, and removed scratch.
